_comment: Hypothesis test: SVS pipeline=100 at bw=1000 Mbps (1 Gbps) on rocketfuel_1755. At 1 Gbps the network has headroom; pipeline=100 creates a large burst to test if it still converges correctly. Run with: sudo ./jobs.sh start --fresh prefix_scale/rocketfuel_1755_onephase_bw1000_pipeline100_3stage
name: rocketfuel_1755_onephase_p0to2000by2000_bw1000Mbps_pipeline100
description: rocketfuel_1755 onephase at bw=1000 Mbps with SVS pipeline=100.

jobs.name: stage1: DV convergence snapshot (onephase, 0 prefixes, bw=1000)
stage2: onephase prefix table measurement p0 (import DV snap, bw=1000, pipeline=100)
stage2: onephase prefix table measurement p2000 (import DV snap, bw=1000, pipeline=100)
